assertions.name: the second-neighbor channel conserves energy inviscidly for every gamma (the pairing telescopes; sanity for the model class)
assertions.source: nu=0 short run, relative energy drift < 1e-4 (RK2 discretization error only)

assertions.name: the two-source per-amplitude equilibrium holds along actual trajectories at every gamma and eps: r_n = sup u_n * nu*k_n / (sup u_{n-1}^2 + gamma*sup u_{n-2}^2) <= 1 on every excited empty-start rung — the per-amplitude route survives second-neighbor nonlocality up to gamma = 1 (equal-strength, harsher than NS triad decay)
assertions.source: max r_n per (gamma, eps) over empty-start rungs

assertions.name: the dissipation-scale crossing B* still exists at every (gamma, eps) and its physical wavenumber still decreases with eps — the collapse condition is not degraded by the nonlocal channel
assertions.source: theta_n profile per rung; k_phys(B*) monotone in eps within each gamma

description: SF8 (bean qou-zoev): nonlocality stress test for the amplitude repair (PR #5066). Extends the DN q-shell model with an energy-conserving second-neighbor transfer channel of strength gamma (inflow gamma*k_n*u_{n-2}^2 paired with outflow -gamma*k_{n+2}*u_n*u_{n+2}; exact telescoping in the energy sum). Measures whether the per-amplitude structure survives: two-source trajectory equilibrium ratio r_n <= 1, dissipation-scale crossing existence and eps-monotonicity. gamma = 1 makes nonlocal transfer as strong as local — harsher than NS, where triads decay with scale separation. Scope (a); float64 RK2 exploratory tier; this probes ONE nonlocality class (second-neighbor), not full NS triad structure.
